summary.name: PDFgear
summary.one_liner: PDFgear is a free PDF editor software and set of browser-based PDF tools for editing, converting, marking up, OCR-ing and signing documents.
use_cases: edit text and images in a PDF
convert PDF to Word, Excel or PowerPoint
merge or split PDF files in a browser
summary.what_it_does: PDFgear offers desktop PDF software for Windows and Mac, plus mobile apps for iOS and Android and dozens of free browser-based PDF tools. Its editor lets users change text, images, shapes, links and fillable form fields in a PDF. It provides markup tools for highlighting, underlining, strikethrough, notes, comments, stamps and shapes. It converts between PDF and formats such as Word, TXT, JPG, Excel and PPT, with a batch mode, and includes OCR for scanned documents in 30+ languages. The page also promotes AI features and a separate eSign service.
notable: OCR for scanned PDFs in 30+ languages
Browser-based PDF tools alongside desktop software
Mac version listed on the App Store
caveats: The page does not state which features, if any, require a paid tier
Mac listing is noted as freeware on awesome-mac; details of the Mac app are not on this page
